name: Rotate
description: Rotates the picture by any angle around its centre, filling the uncovered area with a colour.

params.name: ow
params.description: Output width; 0 = the input's width, -1 = wide enough for the picture rotated by the starting angle (`rotw(a)`)

params.name: oh
params.description: Output height; 0 = the input's height, -1 = tall enough for the picture rotated by the starting angle (`roth(a)`)

params.name: fillcolor
params.description: Colour of the area the picture does not cover (with alpha)
